overview: The Medford School Committee met to receive caucus election results, address high school bathroom maintenance issues, and review reports on the FY 2019 budget closeout and free cash allocation. The committee also recognized student athletic achievements and hosted the Citywide Elementary Alliance raffle drawing.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Bills
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes of the December 16, 2019 meeting alongside payrolls, transfers, and bills.

items.title: Organizational Caucus Report
items.summary: The committee reported out the results of its annual organizational caucus, electing Paul Ruseau as Vice Chair and Paulette Van der Kloot as Secretary.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Report on MIAA Litigation
items.summary: The committee approved motions requesting legal fee estimates and settlement analysis regarding litigation against the MIAA, as well as updated student eligibility policies by March 23, 2020.

items.title: Community Participation and MHS Bathroom Report
items.summary: Following a student petition detailing unsanitary conditions at Medford High School, staff presented maintenance updates and plans to use $100,000 in free cash to fully renovate two restrooms.

items.title: Citywide Elementary Alliance Raffle Drawing
items.summary: Representatives from the Citywide Elementary Alliance reported raising roughly $18,000 across four elementary school PTOs and drew the winning tickets for their Disney vacation raffle.

items.title: Superintendent's Report and Student Recognitions
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Diane Caldwell shared a thank-you letter praising the boys hockey team for their conduct following a spectator death in Norwell, and the committee honored MHS senior Max Stevens for winning a gold medal at the 2019 Winter Deaflympics.

items.title: FY 2019 Budget Closeout Report
items.summary: Finance Director Kirsteen Patterson presented the fiscal year 2019 closeout report, outlining expenditure variances, substitute costs, and revolving fund offsets.

items.title: Free Cash Allocation Report
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Peter Cushing detailed plans for spending $300,000 in approved free cash on intercom repairs, bathroom gut renovations, generator upgrades, window shades, computers, and maker space equipment.

items.title: New Business and Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: The committee tabled a request regarding new agenda formatting and passed condolence resolutions honoring Lawrence Flynn, Lisa Toco-Leonard, Elizabeth Kenny, and Gerard Edward.
